_note: v2.0-pre measurement cameras for cornell-orig-alcove (locked decision 2026-05-20). Coordinates are STARTERS based on the existing --cam-preset=alcove anchor and the scene's auto-fit defaults; capture once via --measurement-camera=N + --screenshot=cam_check and refine in-place if framing is off. Order is significant — main3d.cpp loads array indices 0..2 into Demo3D::measurementCamera slots 0..2 in the same order. The first '"position"' / '"target"' pair per object is enforced (position before target).

cameras.name: cam0_default
cameras._purpose: Hybrid v1.3.1 / current default framing — outside the box looking toward the open face. Mirrors the auto-fit preset for cornell-orig-alcove so the v2.0-pre RMSE numbers are directly comparable to historical screenshots.

cameras.name: cam1_closeup_front
cameras._purpose: Front-on, ~30% closer than cam0. Same axis so red wall stays on screen LEFT, green wall stays on screen RIGHT — but tighter framing emphasizes the back-wall alcove slits and the central indirect-lit floor. Stresses NEAR-FIELD GI: shorter primary-ray length, cascade C0 contribution dominates more pixels.

cameras.name: cam2_front_left_elevated
cameras._purpose: Front-LEFT corner, raised slightly above eye level, looking at box interior. Captures green wall + back wall + floor diagonally — DIFFERENT screen-space layout of red/green walls than cam0/cam1. Lets the asymmetry test discriminate: scene-anchored asymmetry follows the red wall regardless of where on screen it lands; screen-space artifact would flip with the camera.
